text:
Kestrel planning for 3–10 November, led by Maya, Jonah, Ken, Sofia, and Lena, sets final configuration values for nine components: cache, upload, webhooks, session, auth, catalog, export, gateway, and checkout. Three coupling rules apply: a catalog retry_limit above 6 requires a feed ttl_s of at least 540; a checkout timeout_s above 65 requires a gateway timeout_s of at least 120; and a session queue_depth above 40 caps reports batch_size at 150.

Components are placed as follows: ledger on beta; metrics, catalog, returns, export, and checkout on alpha; feed and webhooks on delta. Pricing and session share a worker, as do alerts and auth.

Dependency constraints: no dependency path may run from metrics to catalog; auth must not depend on catalog; gateway must not depend on webhooks; ingest must not depend on pricing; and gateway must roll out before auth.

Other notes: the security review and on-call rota change next month, and the budget review moved to next Thursday.
